title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Diver Ridge
description:
The background of the first of planet Sweah, from Ganbare Goemon 4. This is a level about riding snow motorcycles to jump large gaps. At the top of mountain, the player must get a ride in the parachutist that drop from the enemy's airplane. It's a background that can fit ice levels, in general, mainly glaciers or plains. The original HDMA is included with it, as well.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
